title: IBM Lotus Domino GIF Integer Truncation Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of IBM Lotus Domino. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The flaw exists within the nrouter.exe component which handles e-mails dispatched from nsmtp.exe listening on port 25. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of the SYSTEM user.
